name: Xero
tagline: Accounting with fast reconciliation and a large app market
description: Cloud accounting for small business with fast bank reconciliation, unlimited users on every plan, a large app marketplace and multi-currency for global sellers.
priceNote: US list pricing: Early $27/month, Growing $59/month and Established $97/month, with 90% off for the first six months for new customers and auto-reconciliation at $5/month on Early. Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Small businesses that want clean books plus an ecosystem of apps around them
pros: Bank reconciliation is the smoothest of the three mainstream accounting tools we have tested
Unlimited users on every paid plan, so your accountant joins without buying a seat
The app marketplace covers payroll, inventory, time tracking and ecommerce in one place
Multi-currency and multi-entity support suit sellers who invoice in more than one currency
cons: US list prices rose about 8% in late 2026, and the Early plan caps you at 20 invoices a month
The introductory rate is a six-month promotion, not a permanent price, and renewal jumps
Advanced reporting and multi-entity consolidation only arrive on the expensive Established plan
The interface can feel busy, and setting up a second entity takes real configuration time

features.name: Bank reconciliation
features.detail: Match bank lines to transactions in a few clicks, with rules for repeats

features.name: Unlimited users
features.detail: Every paid plan includes unlimited seats for owners, staff and accountants

features.name: App marketplace
features.detail: Payroll, inventory, time tracking, ecommerce and POS integrations

features.name: Multi-currency
features.detail: Hold multiple currencies and pay suppliers in their own currency

features.name: Invoices and quotes
features.detail: Branded invoices, quotes and payment reminders with online payment

features.name: Multi-entity
features.detail: Manage several entities and consolidate results on Established

useCases: Keep books for an international consultancy that bills in three currencies
Give an owner, three staff and an accountant access without buying extra seats
Connect a small e-commerce store so orders and inventory post to the ledger automatically
Reconcile a busy payment processor payout feed every Friday in minutes
bestForWho: Small and mid-sized businesses that want a partner-friendly accounting tool with a deep app ecosystem around it.
verdict: Xero is the one I recommend when a business has a bookkeeper, an accountant or several people who all need access, because unlimited users on every paid plan removes the seat maths that makes QuickBooks expensive. Bank reconciliation is noticeably quicker here, which matters more to a small team than any feature list, because that task happens every single week. The marketplace is the other strength, with mature payroll, inventory and ecommerce apps that remove the need for a second platform. Two things to plan for: the six-month introductory price is a promotion, and the Early plan's 20-invoice ceiling will catch a growing business sooner than expected. Outside the US, check the local price list first, since the figures here are the US page.
